resources.string: Allow location access to start driving guidance.
Sit in the driver\'s seat to start your rental guide.
While you drive, guidance comes by voice and notifications. You can continue the lessons after you stop.
Checking the car\'s status. Please try again in a moment.
Stop the car and shift into P to open this.

Want a quick look at Korean driving rules?
You can only view this while the car is stopped. It closes as soon as you start driving.
Before you set off, check every seat belt, the fuel type, and the return location and time.
Before you set off, check every seat belt, how to charge and where the charging port is, and the return location and time.
Cars drive on the right side of the road, and the driver\'s seat is on the left. After a left turn, do not enter the lane for oncoming traffic.
School zones have lower speed limits. Follow the posted limit. At a crosswalk without traffic lights, stop briefly before crossing even if no one is there.

With an \'unprotected left turn\' (비보호) sign, turn left on green only when you do not block oncoming cars or pedestrians. When turning right, let pedestrians on the crosswalk go first. In a roundabout, cars already circling go first.
Speed and distance are shown in km/h and km. Speed limits differ by road, so follow the signs and your navigation.
\'정지\' means stop, \'서행\' means slow down, and \'진입금지\' means do not enter. On an \'일방통행\' (one-way) road, drive only in the direction of the arrow.
Which side of the road do cars drive on in Korea?
Korea drives on the right. After a left turn, also enter the right-hand lane.
In a school zone, what do you do at a crosswalk without traffic lights?
Stop only when you see a pedestrian
Stop briefly even if no one is there, then go
In a school zone, you must stop briefly at a crosswalk without traffic lights even if no one is there.
At an intersection with an \'unprotected left turn\' (비보호) sign, when can you turn left?
Only when the left-turn arrow is on
On green, when you do not block oncoming cars or pedestrians
An unprotected left turn is allowed only on green, and only when you do not block oncoming cars or pedestrians.
When turning right, what do you do if there are pedestrians on the crosswalk?
Stop and wait until they have crossed
When turning right, stop and wait if someone is crossing or about to cross.
Who goes first when entering a roundabout?
In a roundabout, cars already circling go first. Yield, then enter.
